description: This file contains SQL definitions for types, tables, indexes, functions, and triggers related to email scheduling and delivery logs within a reporting system. It defines enumerations for report formats and types, tables for scheduling reports and logging delivery status, with associated indexes and a trigger to update timestamps.

methods.name: set_updated_at
methods.description: Trigger function that updates the 'updated_at' timestamp column before any update on the report_schedules table.
